sections.html: The natural distribution of the species is in Venezuela, where it inhabits the upper reaches of the rivers Orinoco and Rio Negro.
Like all members of the genus Laetacara the fish are comparatively peaceful and do not destroy plants.
The species is an open brooder with a pair family.

Only very rarely this beautiful dwarf cichlid becomes imported. Nevertheless it is known in the hobby for quite a long time. Since 1978 it was named "Aequidens sp. Orange Fin", later, after the splitting of Aequidens and Laetacara in separate genera, Laetacara sp. "Orange Fin". The scientifically valid description appeared only in 2007, when Staeck and Schindler named the species Laetacara fulvipinnis.

Recently imported fish were large, fully grown specimens. The largest males are almost 9 cm long (including the caudal fin).
